bodies.name: Goblin
bodies.note: The armour was drawn for human bodies. On the goblin it is far too long and the hats far too big: goblin gear needs its own pictures.

bodies.name: Goblin warrior
bodies.note: Kept for history: the owner picked Tripo (2026-11-23); not shown on the Enemies stage.

bodies.name: Street thug
bodies.note: Test job thug-tripo (face_limit 8000, then cut down here) is the losing half of the low-poly comparison; it is paid for but not used.

bodies.name: Bounty hunter
bodies.note: Meshy refused the long coat on its usual skeleton twice; rigged on Meshy's default skeleton instead and moved over with to_ual.py --meshy-default. The knees sit unevenly (one is low), hidden by the coat.

bodies.name: Dire wolf
bodies.note: Rigged here (tools/blender/quad_rig.py), not by the paid Tripo rig (wolf-rig gave only two legs); motion from js/beast.js.

bodies.name: Drake
bodies.note: Rigged here (tools/blender/quad_rig.py --wings), not by the paid Tripo rig (drake-rig lost the back legs); motion from js/beast.js.

bodies.name: Brown bear
bodies.note: Rigged here (tools/blender/quad_rig.py --straighten), motion from js/beast.js; no paid rig. A real bear (owner 2026-11-23): also the druid's bear form.

bodies.name: Bristleback boar
bodies.note: Rigged here (tools/blender/quad_rig.py --straighten), motion from js/beast.js; no paid rig.

bodies.name: Mountain lion
bodies.note: Rigged here (tools/blender/quad_rig.py --straighten), motion from js/beast.js; no paid rig. A real big cat (owner 2026-11-23): a druid cat-form candidate. Came back turned ~20°: straightened.

bodies.name: Bandit chief
bodies.note: Rigged 2026-11-23 (Meshy, round 2). Holds his own chief-axe (round 3) + the roster shield until his chief-buckler is made.

bodies.name: Field scarecrow
bodies.note: Rigged 2026-11-23 (Meshy, round 2). Holds the zealot sickle until his own rusty-pitchfork (drawn) can be paid for.

bodies.name: Riding horse
bodies.note: Mount (owner 2026-11-23). Made 2026-11-24 (round 3): Tripo P1, rigged free by quad_rig.py --straighten.

mount.measured: 2026-11-24 on riding-horse.glb (0.83 tall as made): top of the saddle over the middle of spine_2 = 0.654 up, 0.178 forward of the origin; scaled to 1.75 m

bodies.reviewNote: The wings are joined to the arms (as feared): they hang from the arms and move with them, no wing motion of their own.

items.name: Hunter shortbow
items.reviewNote: The bowstring did not come through (thin strings vanish in Trellis); the wood is fine.

scenery.name: Palisade wall
scenery.reviewNote: The stakes came back crumpled into sharp shards; the wall does not read as a row of logs.

scenery.name: Palisade corner
scenery.reviewNote: Crumpled like the wall piece: shards instead of round stakes.

scenery.name: Haystack
scenery.reviewNote: An open see-through lattice dome, not a solid haystack.

scenery.name: Signpost
scenery.reviewNote: Came back with a second bare post standing beside the sign.

scenery.name: Low stone wall
scenery.reviewNote: The woodpile's axe came back stuck into the end of this wall.

scenery.name: Wood pile
scenery.reviewNote: Came back as one crumpled lump; the stacked logs do not read.

scenery.name: Small tent
scenery.reviewNote: Only the pole frame came back: the canvas is missing, so you can see straight through it.

scenery.name: Crate stack
scenery.reviewNote: Open see-through lattice instead of solid crates (the same fault as the round-1 crate).

scenery.name: Tower stump
scenery.reviewNote: Broke into floating pieces with holes; not a solid tower.

scenery.name: Barrow entrance
scenery.reviewNote: The stone doorway came back beside the mound instead of set into it; the mound is half a shape.

scenery.name: Goblin hut
scenery.reviewNote: Came back as a thin open shell with gaps; you can see through the walls.

scenery.name: Water trough
scenery.reviewNote: A stray straw face (from the scarecrow on the same drawing) is stuck under the trough.

scenery.name: Boardwalk
scenery.reviewNote: Came back as one bent plank, not a walkway.
